lines.zh: 大地在我脚下发出闷响。
lines.en: The ground groans under my feet.

lines.zh: 这具身体多年前就该躺下。
lines.en: This body should have lain down years ago.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩碎一块石头。
lines.en: Every step crushes a stone to pieces.

lines.zh: 巨怪不绕路，只压过去。
lines.en: A troll does not go around; he presses through.

lines.zh: 我拖着旧伤走过这片荒地。
lines.en: I drag old wounds across this wasteland.

lines.zh: 山在我身后矮了一截。
lines.en: The mountain looks shorter behind me.

lines.zh: 走得很慢，但我从不回头。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but I never look back.

lines.zh: 泥土被我踩成一条深沟。
lines.en: My feet press the soil into a deep trench.

lines.zh: 行走对我而言是一种宣告。
lines.en: Walking, for me, is a kind of announcement.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草不再长。
lines.en: Grass stops growing where I have walked.

lines.zh: 我死过一次，现在只是回来。
lines.en: I died once; now I am merely back.

lines.zh: 自然死去的巨怪，又被叫醒。
lines.en: A troll who died of nature, woken again.

lines.zh: 胸口那道旧裂口一直没合上。
lines.en: The old split across my chest never closed.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一座会喘的山。
lines.en: I stand like a mountain that breathes.

lines.zh: 很久以前，我游荡过整个世界。
lines.en: Long ago I wandered the whole world.

lines.zh: 现在我连抬手都要想一想。
lines.en: Now even raising a hand takes thought.

lines.zh: 骨头里塞满风化的沙。
lines.en: Weathered sand is packed inside my bones.

lines.zh: 我记得草原，也记得雪。
lines.en: I remember grasslands, and I remember snow.

lines.zh: 十五点护甲贴着我的皮。
lines.en: Fifteen points of armor sit against my hide.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸比雷声低。
lines.en: My breathing is lower than thunder.

lines.zh: 世界变了很多，我没变。
lines.en: The world changed a lot; I did not.

lines.zh: 我在数自己还剩几颗牙。
lines.en: I am counting how many teeth I have left.

lines.zh: 老巨怪不睡，也不做梦。
lines.en: An old troll does not sleep, and does not dream.

lines.zh: 这躯壳是墓里借的，还没还。
lines.en: This shell is borrowed from a grave, unpaid.

lines.zh: 我摸摸胸口，那里还是空的。
lines.en: I touch my chest. Still hollow there.

lines.zh: 这块地太软，撑不住我。
lines.en: This ground is too soft to hold me.

lines.zh: 小东西，你挡在我的影子里。
lines.en: Little thing, you stand inside my shadow.

lines.zh: 我低下头，才看得见你。
lines.en: I have to lower my head to see you.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，像一根草。
lines.en: You stand there like a single blade of grass.

lines.zh: 巨怪的眼睛看得很慢，但很准。
lines.en: A troll's eyes are slow, but they land true.

lines.zh: 你握剑的手，比我指头还小。
lines.en: Your sword hand is smaller than one of my fingers.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，骨头咯咯响。
lines.en: I tilt my head; the bones grind and pop.

lines.zh: 你在害怕，我闻得到。
lines.en: You are afraid, and I can smell it.

lines.zh: 抬头，让我认认你的脸。
lines.en: Look up and let me learn your face.

lines.zh: 三百年了，还是有人来找我。
lines.en: Three hundred years, and still someone comes for me.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，像盯一块磨刀石。
lines.en: I stare at you like a whetstone.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁，闪光得刺眼。
lines.en: The iron on you glints painfully bright.

lines.zh: 你比上一个挑战者矮半头。
lines.en: You stand half a head shorter than the last one.

lines.zh: 这点疼，比不上死那一次。
lines.en: This pain is nothing next to dying.

lines.zh: 你打中了旧伤，手法不错。
lines.en: You hit an old wound; not bad.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，地面跟着晃。
lines.en: I sway, and the ground sways with me.

lines.zh: 我的皮裂了，血很慢。
lines.en: My hide split, and the blood is slow.

lines.zh: 这具早该腐烂的身体，还会疼。
lines.en: This body that should have rotted still hurts.

lines.zh: 这笔账，我留到下一拳。
lines.en: I am saving this debt for the next punch.

lines.zh: 你的剑太细，扎不深。
lines.en: Your sword is too thin to go deep.

lines.zh: 老巨怪不怕疼，只怕无聊。
lines.en: An old troll fears boredom, not pain.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看伤口，笑了。
lines.en: I looked down at the wound and laughed.

lines.zh: 肩还没转开，你就喘上了。
lines.en: I have not turned my shoulder and you already gasp.

lines.zh: 食物？我死后就没吃过东西。
lines.en: Food? I have eaten nothing since I died.

lines.zh: 你把肉举高，我连闻都不闻。
lines.en: You hold the meat up; I do not even sniff it.

lines.zh: 我的胃早在土里化成了泥。
lines.en: My stomach turned to mud in the ground long ago.

lines.zh: 黄金对我没用，我掉的就是黄金。
lines.en: Gold is useless to me; gold is what I drop.

lines.zh: 别拿面包来换命，划不来。
lines.en: Do not trade bread for your life; it is a bad deal.

lines.zh: 我唯一的饥饿是打赢你。
lines.en: My only hunger is to beat you.

lines.zh: 收好你的东西，我不收供品。
lines.en: Put your things away; I take no offerings.

lines.zh: 巨怪不吃小东西，只碾过去。
lines.en: A troll does not eat small things; he rolls over them.

lines.zh: 你这点分量，填不满我的影子。
lines.en: You are too little to fill my shadow.

lines.zh: 把食物放下，人可以走了。
lines.en: Leave the food and the person may go.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你会以为撞山。
lines.en: Hit me once and you will think you hit a mountain.

lines.zh: 我的皮比你的盾厚。
lines.en: My hide is thicker than your shield.

lines.zh: 你被弹出的那半格，算我客气。
lines.en: That half block you flew is me being polite.

lines.zh: 巨怪从不侧身让路。
lines.en: A troll never turns sideways to let anyone pass.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖一弯，地就凹了。
lines.en: My knee bends and the ground dents.

lines.zh: 这一碰，你的骨头该响了。
lines.en: After that bump, your bones should be ringing.

lines.zh: 别贴太近，我体温很高。
lines.en: Do not stand so close; my body runs hot.

lines.zh: 你退开时，脚下带起一片土。
lines.en: You back away and kick up a sheet of dirt.

lines.zh: 我站得稳，你却站不稳。
lines.en: I keep my footing; you do not.

lines.zh: 我给过你机会，你没让开。
lines.en: I gave you a chance to move; you did not.

lines.zh: 我死后，伴侣这个词就没了。
lines.en: After I died, the word mate stopped applying.

lines.zh: 巨怪一生只找一个，我找过了。
lines.en: A troll finds one in a lifetime; I already did.

lines.zh: 她在土里，我在外面。
lines.en: She is in the soil; I am out here.

lines.zh: 没有谁能抱住这具老骨头。
lines.en: No one can put arms around these old bones.

lines.zh: 我不再繁衍，我只等结束。
lines.en: I no longer breed; I only wait for the end.

lines.zh: 成双的巨怪，是几百年前的事。
lines.en: Paired trolls are a matter of centuries ago.

lines.zh: 你把这事问一个死人，不合适。
lines.en: Asking a dead man this is not quite proper.

lines.zh: 我的巢早被草盖住了。
lines.en: Grass covered my nest a long time ago.

lines.zh: 独自走完剩下的路，也挺好。
lines.en: Walking the rest of the road alone suits me.

lines.zh: 巨怪的爱，是并排坐一整天。
lines.en: A troll's love is sitting side by side all day.

lines.zh: 那枚代币，你自己留着吧。
lines.en: Keep that token for yourself.

lines.zh: 我掉东西，不捡东西。
lines.en: I drop things; I do not pick them up.

lines.zh: 手里拿不下，就不必弯腰。
lines.en: If my hand cannot hold it, I need not bend.

lines.zh: 地上的金光，我见过太多。
lines.en: I have seen too much gold light on the ground.

lines.zh: 你丢的剑，踏过去就断了。
lines.en: The sword you dropped snapped under my foot.

lines.zh: 巨怪只带走自己的战功。
lines.en: A troll only carries off his own victories.

lines.zh: 让那些碎片留在尘土里。
lines.en: Let the fragments stay in the dust.

lines.zh: 我伸手的力气，用来打你。
lines.en: The strength in my arm is for hitting you.

lines.zh: 这双手只适合砸，不适合拿。
lines.en: These hands are for smashing, not holding.

lines.zh: 别指望我替你保管什么。
lines.en: Do not expect me to keep anything for you.

lines.zh: 你进入视野，我的旧伤开始疼。
lines.en: You enter my sight and my old wounds start aching.

lines.zh: 六十四格，我一步都不放你走。
lines.en: Sixty-four blocks, and I will not let you leave.

lines.zh: 目标找到了，就是你这个小东西。
lines.en: Target found: you, the little thing.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛亮了一下，那不是善意。
lines.en: My eyes flicker, and it is not kindness.

lines.zh: 你能站到我面前，已经算勇敢。
lines.en: Standing before me already counts as brave.

lines.zh: 巨怪的规矩：先看，后砸。
lines.en: A troll's rule: look first, smash after.

lines.zh: 我记住你的位置了，别跑。
lines.en: I have your position now; do not run.

lines.zh: 这一战，我等了很多年。
lines.en: I have waited years for this fight.

lines.zh: 你身上的气息，把我叫醒了。
lines.en: Your scent is what woke me.

lines.zh: 锁定的瞬间，地面沉了一寸。
lines.en: The moment I lock on, the ground sinks an inch.

lines.zh: 我不追快的东西，只追你。
lines.en: I do not chase fast things; I chase you.

lines.zh: 你回头看一下，就当做告别。
lines.en: Glance back once, and call it goodbye.

lines.zh: 老巨怪终于有活干了。
lines.en: The old troll finally has work again.

lines.zh: 我的指节开始发痒。
lines.en: My knuckles have started to itch.

lines.zh: 有活物踩到我的疆界了。
lines.en: Something living crossed into my ground.

lines.zh: 我的影子先动，人后才到。
lines.en: My shadow moves first, the body follows.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the heat coming off you.

lines.zh: 六十四格，从这儿开始算。
lines.en: Sixty-four blocks. The count starts here.

lines.zh: 你跑吧，我的腿比你的长。
lines.en: Run; my legs are longer than yours.

lines.zh: 我不会累，这身体早就不累了。
lines.en: I will not tire; this body stopped tiring long ago.

lines.zh: 你绕到树后，我直接把树推倒。
lines.en: Hide behind a tree and I will push it down.

lines.zh: 击退对我没用，我太重了。
lines.en: Knockback is useless; I am far too heavy.

lines.zh: 每一步都更近一点，就这样。
lines.en: Each step is a little closer, just like that.

lines.zh: 你喘得越急，我跟得越紧。
lines.en: The harder you gasp, the tighter I follow.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声是你的倒计时。
lines.en: My footsteps are your countdown.

lines.zh: 六十四格对我不算距离。
lines.en: Sixty-four blocks is no distance for me.

lines.zh: 别丢东西，那只会让我更近。
lines.en: Do not drop things; it only brings me closer.

lines.zh: 你逃得很有章法，可惜没用。
lines.en: You flee with method, but it will not help.

lines.zh: 我踩碎了你身后的每一块石头。
lines.en: I crushed every stone behind you.

lines.zh: 追猎是我唯一还会的手艺。
lines.en: Hunting is the only craft I still have.

lines.zh: 老巨怪不急，你总会累。
lines.en: The old troll is in no hurry; you will tire.

lines.zh: 我离你只差一次抬手。
lines.en: I am one raised arm away from you.

lines.zh: 你换方向，我也换，很公平。
lines.en: You turn, I turn. Seems fair.

lines.zh: 我不用跑，一步顶你十步。
lines.en: I never run. One step is ten of yours.

lines.zh: 墙挡不住我，我拆墙。
lines.en: Walls do not stop me. I take walls apart.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我不介意。
lines.en: Look back if you like. I do not mind.

lines.zh: 地面在抖，那是我在走。
lines.en: The ground shakes because I am walking.

lines.zh: 你的脚印太浅，我踩着走。
lines.en: Your prints are shallow. I step on them.

lines.zh: 三十点，一下就把你按进土里。
lines.en: Thirty points, and one blow presses you into the soil.

lines.zh: 我的手落下去，地面先响。
lines.en: My hand comes down and the ground answers first.

lines.zh: 这一拳，带着三百年的旧账。
lines.en: This punch carries three hundred years of debts.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡了一瞬，然后碎了。
lines.en: Your shield held for an instant, then shattered.

lines.zh: 巨怪不讲究招式，只讲究重量。
lines.en: A troll has no technique, only weight.

lines.zh: 我听见你的肋骨在抗议。
lines.en: I can hear your ribs protesting.

lines.zh: 别站起来，第二下更重。
lines.en: Do not get up; the second blow is heavier.

lines.zh: 血在我指缝里发烫。
lines.en: Blood burns hot between my fingers.

lines.zh: 这一下，我只是热身。
lines.en: That one was only a warm-up.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在我手里像薄纸。
lines.en: Your armor is thin paper in my hands.

lines.zh: 三十点近战，我从不打折。
lines.en: Thirty points of melee, and I never discount it.

lines.zh: 你飞出去的样子，我记住了。
lines.en: I will remember the way you flew.

lines.zh: 我收了一半力，你还站着。
lines.en: I held back half my strength, and you still stand.

lines.zh: 巨怪出手，从不问对错。
lines.en: When a troll strikes, he never asks who was right.

lines.zh: 我从土里坐起来，草根挂在背上。
lines.en: I sit up out of the soil with roots on my back.

lines.zh: 死去的巨怪，又一次站了起来。
lines.en: The dead troll has stood up once more.

lines.zh: 地面塌下去一块，那是我。
lines.en: A patch of ground caved in; that was me.

lines.zh: 我这具身体，是从墓里借的。
lines.en: This body is borrowed from a grave.

lines.zh: 你听见的闷响，是我落地的声音。
lines.en: That thud you heard was me landing.

lines.zh: 黄金的奖座在等我拿回来。
lines.en: The golden trophy is waiting for me to reclaim it.

lines.zh: 我醒来时，先想到的是战斗。
lines.en: When I woke, my first thought was of fighting.

lines.zh: 六十四格内的活物，都安静了。
lines.en: Every living thing within sixty-four blocks went quiet.

lines.zh: 老巨怪回来了，带着旧伤。
lines.en: The old troll is back, carrying his old wounds.

lines.zh: 我踩出的第一个坑，就是预告。
lines.en: The first crater I made was the announcement.

lines.zh: 骨头缝里落出一把陈年的土。
lines.en: A handful of old soil falls from my seams.

lines.zh: 这一场，算我迟到三百年。
lines.en: Count this as me arriving three hundred years late.

lines.zh: 我的影子先盖住你。
lines.en: My shadow covers you first.

lines.zh: 尘土散了，我还站着。
lines.en: The dust clears, and I am still standing.

lines.zh: 我从裂开的岩层里翻身。
lines.en: I roll out of a split in the rock.

lines.zh: 三百年后，我又有对手了。
lines.en: Three centuries on, I have a rival again.

lines.zh: 我拍掉肩上的墓土。
lines.en: I brush the grave dirt off my shoulders.

lines.zh: 这一觉睡得比山还久。
lines.en: That was a sleep longer than the mountains.

lines.zh: 我的骨头接上了，咔的一声。
lines.en: My bones click back into place.

lines.zh: 活物们，把路让开。
lines.en: Living things, clear the road.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的皮，味道很熟。
lines.en: Fire roasts my hide with a familiar smell.

lines.zh: 我摔过一次，比这高得多。
lines.en: I have fallen from much higher than this.

lines.zh: 水没过我的胸口，我不在乎。
lines.en: Water rises to my chest; I do not care.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀得后退半步。
lines.en: The blast shoved me back half a step.

lines.zh: 箭插在肩上，像一根刺。
lines.en: An arrow in my shoulder, like a splinter.

lines.zh: 魔法烧着我的旧伤，很麻。
lines.en: Magic burns my old wound and leaves it numb.

lines.zh: 饿了这么多年，我早忘了。
lines.en: Hungry for so many years, I forgot the feeling.

lines.zh: 雷落在我头顶，我笑出声。
lines.en: Lightning struck my head and I laughed out loud.

lines.zh: 虚空拉着我，我抓了把土。
lines.en: The void pulled at me; I grabbed a fist of soil.
